# Bighorn Painting, Wheat Ridge CO

> House painting company serving Wheat Ridge, Colorado (80033, 80212 and 80214). Specialists in the mid-century, pre-1978 housing that makes up most of this city: interior and exterior painting, original trim preservation, kitchen cabinets, popcorn ceiling removal with asbestos testing, deck and fence staining, and small business work. Rated 4.9 stars from 95 Google reviews. Free estimates, written 5-year workmanship warranty, fully insured.
